newsitem.title: FRANCE: Accor up, Morgan Stanley calls strong buy.
newsitem.headline: Accor up, Morgan Stanley calls strong buy.

text.p: Shares in French hotels group Accor rose on Friday and U.S. investment firm Morgan Stanley said it was initiating coverage of the stock with a "strong buy" recommendation.
The share was up 1.16 percent at 784 francs, with nearly 100,000 shares traded at 1155 GMT, in a weaker market.
"The share has progressed well since the start but given the poor performance over last year, it should stay on a rising trend," a member of the U.S. firm's analysis team told Reuters.
Morgan Stanley also interpreted as positive the change of leadership. Jean-Marc Espalioux recently took the reins as chairman, replacing co-founders Paul Dubrule et Gerard Pelisson.
